meta.name: init-first-agent
meta.description: Walk the operator through wiring the first NanoClaw agent to a DM channel — resolve the operator's channel identity, select or create the agent, and trigger a welcome DM via the normal delivery path. Use after channel credentials are configured and the service is running.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把首个智能体接入私信频道并发出欢迎消息
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你刚布置好智能体服务,想快速接通私信频道。
copy.tagline_en: Connect your first agent to a DM channel and send a welcome message
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you've just set up an agent service and want to quickly wire it to a DM channel.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会带你创建第一个 NanoClaw 智能体：确认你在目标频道上的身份、把私聊消息组接到新智能体，并让它通过正常投递路径给你发一条欢迎私信。所有操作可重复执行。
howto.when: 在频道凭据已配置、服务正在运行之后使用；典型时机是你要给某个私聊频道建第一个智能体时。

say.text: 帮我初始化第一个智能体，用 Discord 频道
say.note: 之后它会问你用户 ID、显示名等

say.text: 给 Telegram 新建一个私聊智能体，显示名用 Alice
say.note: 会建 dm-with 分组并发欢迎私信

say.text: 欢迎私信没收到，帮我查一下出站消息状态
say.note: 它会直接查 outbound.db 排错

howto.what_en: Guides you through creating the first NanoClaw agent for a DM channel: resolving your channel identity, wiring the DM messaging group to a new agent, and triggering a welcome DM via the normal delivery path. All steps are idempotent.
howto.when_en: Use after channel credentials are configured and the service is running, when you want to stand up the first agent for a DM channel.

say_en.text: Walk me through setting up my first agent on the Discord channel
say_en.note: It will then ask for your user ID and names

say_en.text: Create a Telegram DM agent with display name Alice
say_en.note: It creates a dm-with group and sends a welcome DM

say_en.text: The welcome DM didn't arrive — check the outbound messages
